purpose: Define the safe SEIS model scaling path from a 20B local-compatibility target for 16GB+ RAM machines toward future 70B, 150B, and larger parameter classes without claiming trained weights or live runtime readiness.
truthBoundary: Repository-local model scaling and hardware compatibility profile only. It creates no trained 20B, 70B, or 150B weights, performs no model download, performs no inference, performs no benchmark, performs no live provider calls, performs no cloud fine-tuning, and does not claim SEIS owns a trained foundation model.

notes: 16GB+ is a target compatibility class, not a verified throughput or memory claim.
The target can become selectable only after clean-room provenance, quantized runtime, memory ceiling tests, redaction tests, and human approval exist.
Core SEIS continues to run with zero cloud provider keys by falling back to Local Demo mode.

frontierTarget.targetHardwareClass: approved distributed, multi-accelerator, or cloud research runtime
notes: 150B is a long-horizon SEIS AI research objective, not a local 16GB+ compatibility promise.
No 150B download, training, fine-tuning, inference, benchmark, publication, deployment, SSH, or cloud provisioning is authorized by this profile.
The 150B lane can become scoped only after the 20B and 70B gates produce real evidence and a separate human-approved frontier research plan exists.

planningAssumptions: 20B on 16GB+ requires a quantized local runtime profile.
Usable context length, OS memory pressure, GPU/CPU split, KV cache, tokenizer, runtime overhead, and background apps must be measured on real hardware.
A planning estimate cannot be used as a benchmark or production readiness claim.
